map.节奏训练（随机节奏点击） 使用指南: Rhythm Training (Random Rhythm Clicking) User Guide
map.随机播放节奏型要求跟点，训练节拍感与稳定度，统计准确率与速度，适合乐器入门，纯前: Randomly plays rhythmic patterns to tap along to, training beat sense and steadiness and tracking accuracy and speed; it suits beginners on an instrument and runs entirely in the browser.
map.鼓手/器乐练习者跟随机节奏型用空格或点击敲击，练稳定律动: Drummers and instrumentalists tap along to random rhythms with space or clicks, building steady groove
map.设定 BPM 与节拍器对齐，实时看击打偏差改善时值准确度: Set a BPM and align with the metronome, then watch the strike deviation improve in real time to sharpen timing accuracy
map.切换不同细分（八分、十六分、三连音）提升复杂节奏读谱: Switch between subdivisions (eighths, sixteenths, triplets) to improve reading of complex rhythms
map.：节拍器 100 BPM（每拍 600 ms），你应在拍点 ±30 ms 内敲击: With a metronome at 100 BPM (600 ms per beat), you should strike within +/-30 ms of the beat; a consistent deviation of +120 ms means you are dragging and need to start earlier.
map.：120 BPM 下八分音符间隔 250 ms、十六分 125 ms、八分三连音: At 120 BPM the eighth-note interval is 250 ms, the sixteenth is 125 ms, and an eighth-note triplet puts 3 notes in 500 ms (about 166.7 ms each); random questions train switching between intervals.

map.节奏训练器靠什么评分？: How Does the Rhythm Trainer Score?
map.以节拍器拍点为基准，记录你每次击打的时间戳，算与最近拍点的偏差毫秒数与标准差，越: Use the metronome beat as the reference and record the timestamp of every strike; compute the deviation in milliseconds from the nearest beat and the standard deviation, and the closer to 0 the steadier you are.
map.三连音为什么难跟？: Why Are Triplets Hard to Keep Up With?
map.三连音把一拍均分 3 份（非 2 或 4），大脑习惯二分节奏，需先慢速内化 16: Triplets split one beat into 3 equal parts (not 2 or 4), while the brain is used to binary rhythm, so first internalize the even feel of 166.7 ms per note at a slow tempo before speeding up.
